authority: Outcome-blind protocol. No participant angle or model score was inspected when these choices were made. S1 is the only permitted export-format development subject.

participants.selection: Closed numerical ranges. One ZXY angle file per available participant at this one speed. S1 is training. Reject unexpected missing files until documented. Leave reserve and other speeds unopened. Hash the six-column numeric series to detect duplicates. If identical, keep one training copy, exclude any test copy matching a training series, and include a given remaining test series only once. Report all exclusions.

variables.representation: ZXY lower-limb flexion/extension outputs in degrees, using semantic axis headers where present. Target is bilateral knee flexion/extension in the stored IMU-derived estimates. These are retrospective Xsens reconstructions.
variables.anchoring: Fit and score only complete finite sequences whose source Frame increments by one throughout the supporting 40 frames. A missing frame breaks the window. If no integer frame column exists, use stored-row units only with explicit separate reporting. 60 Hz is a device specification. No resampling from duration, smoothing, post-cutoff imputation, measured latent neural interpretation or external sample-time claim.
variables.modality: Primary uses within-file IMU angle history alone. Any cross-modal comparison requires an auditable shared trial origin, envelope temporal support and explicit clock/lag. Without that evidence do not add crossmodal features.

models.slope: Last knees + (15/6)*(last knees - knees six frames earlier).
models.knee_ridge: Five-by-two raw histories standardized using equal-participant training moments per feature. Predict future-minus-last knees with intercept; ridge penalty 0.001 on mean normalized covariance.
models.transformer: Separately trained gait specialist. Chronological five-token 6D histories, train-only feature normalization across participants and time tokens, affine embed 24 with learned 5x24 position table, one pre-norm residual block of four 6D softmax attention heads and a 48-unit ReLU feedforward, last token layernorm and affine bilateral readout. Predict knee delta divided by 20 degrees; add last knees. Float32 training, no dropout, MSE of scaled delta, AdamW lr 0.002 wd 0.001, seed 81037, 700 updates of 128 cutoffs, uniform training participants then uniform eligible cutoffs with replacement. All tokens are historical relative to the forecast; this is one end-of-window forecast.

analysis.training_cutoffs: Every eligible anchor; equal participant weight. Use last fixed transformer checkpoint and predetermined ridge constants. No held-person selection, refit or tuning.
analysis.score: For each participant average absolute degree error across cutoffs and both knees. Mean of these participant scores is primary; report each knee separately and paired participant win counts/differences. Uncertainty via participant paired bootstrap 10000 resamplings seed 21301, descriptive only. Overlapping windows are not independent samples.
analysis.controls: Persistence, six-frame slope, knee-only ridge, all-joint ridge, and independent reviewer-selected coded phase comparator if supported. Alter future angles after a cutoff to verify invariant model inputs/prediction and changed future labels. Challenge non-knee history by swapping hips/ankles across time within TEST only as an explicitly non-deployable perturbation. Model performance is reported even if it loses.
analysis.public: Invented six-joint example only. No raw participant kinematics, EEG/EMG, free-text headers, demographics or private material. Public links, train/test ranges, terms, source checks, code, aggregate scores and portable weights.
